z-m-33-01.title: Marka saddex dhibcood la bixiyo, barta hadhay ma mid keliya baa?
z-m-33-01.topic: Nemo geeska afraad ee barbarro marka saddex gees la bixiyo
z-m-33-01.goal: Go'aami haddii geeska afraad lagu go'aamin karo saddex dhibcood oo keliya, sababta uu u xaddidnayn iyo xogta dheeraadka ah (sida kala horreynta magacyada geesaha), dabadeed adigu hel dhibcaha suurtagalka ah.
z-m-33-01.material: Diyaaradda coordinate-ka waxaa yaal A(0,0), B(4,1), C(5,4), mana wada saarna hal xariiq. Dooro D si A,B,C,D u noqdaan geesaha barbarro. Su'aasha asalka ahi waxay leedahay 'geeska afraad D ha noqdo' balse ma sheegto kala horreynta geesaha. Isku-duwayaashu waa tirooyin dhab ah, afarta dhibcoodna way kala duwan yihiin. (0, 0, 1, 4, 4, 5)
z-m-33-01.thinking.1: Kala qaybi kiisaska suurtagalka ah oo hel dhammaantood
z-m-33-01.thinking.2: Sharax sida xog dheeraad ahi u yarayso kiisaska
z-m-33-01.prereq.0: Ku sawir dhibco coordinate oo akhri jihada iyo masaafada u dhexaysa laba dhibcood
z-m-33-01.prereq.1: Sifooyinka barbarro (dhinacyada iska soo horjeeda is barbar socda oo le'eg, diagonals-ku is kala qaybiyaan) - heer dugsi dhexe
z-m-33-01.prereq.2: (Shaqadan H2 waxaa loo doortay habayn ahaan; waa heerka adag ee shaqada, ma aha fasal. Waxaa loo qaadanayaa in la barto ka dib 'coordinates-ka fidsan' ee xisaabta guud.)
z-m-33-01.s.s1.prompt: Xogta sare ma go'aamisay booska D? Dooro go'aanka ugu habboon.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ku sawir A,B,C coordinate plane oo ku dar dhibic afraad si ay barbarro u noqdaan.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mar kasta beddel labada dhibcood ee ka soo horjeeda D, sawir D, isha ku hubi in dhinacyada iska soo horjeeda is barbar socdaan.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.a: Hal meel ayaa go'an. Saddex dhibcood waa go'an yihiin, sidaas darteed barta ugu dambaysa waa hal keliya.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u qaadatay marka saddex dhibcood la go'aamiyo in tan afraadna hal noqoto. Xusuusnow magacyada afar geesoodka (ABCD) waxay leeyihiin kala horreyn.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.b: Ma go'ana. Dhinacyada oo keliya ayaa u baahan isbarbar, sidaas darteed kuwo aan dhammaad lahayn ayaa jira.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad shuruudda isbarbar u akhriday hal lammaane oo keliya. Barbarro wuxuu leeyahay labada lammaane oo isbarbar ah, laba shuruudood oo kale ayaana barta go'aamiya. Adigu sawir si aad u hubiso.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.c: Ma go'ana. Waxay ku xiran tahay dhibicda laga dhigo mid ka soo horjeedda midkee.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad tilmaantay in D is beddesho marka lammaanaha iska soo horjeeda is beddelo. Haddii aad tiriso lammaanayaasha suurtagalka ah waxaad arki doontaa tirada.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.d: Ma go'ana. Laba dhibcood ayaa suurtagal ah. (2)
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad aragtay dhowr D laakiin waxaad u badan tahay inaad qaar keliya tirisay. Mid mid u eeg dhammaan dhibcaha ka soo horjeedi kara D.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.explain: Waxay ku xiran tahay midka A,B,C ka mid ah ee D ka soo horjeeda, sidaas darteed saddex boos oo D ah ayaa jira. Haddii la bixiyo kala horreynta magacyada (tusaale ABCD), lammaanayaasha iska soo horjeeda waa go'an, D-na hal ayuu noqdaa. Xogta dheeraadka ahi waa kala horreynta geesaha.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo geli 3 dhibcood D(x,y) oo kala duwan oo shuruudda buuxiya. Afarta dhibcood inay geesaha barbarro noqdaan kala horreyn uun baa ku filan. Sanduuqa hoose marka hore isku-duwayaasha keliya qor, dabadeed sababaha.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro mid ka mid ah saddexda dhibcood oo ku sheeg 'ka soo horjeedda D', ka dib eeg xidhiidhka D la leeyahay qaybta isku xidha labada kale.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.1: U beddel dhibicda ka soo horjeedda sida A,B,C, isbarbar dhig D-yada ka dhasha inay kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Booskan A,B,C,D waxay noqdaan geesaha barbarro.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.fail.c1: D-gan haddii lagu daro, isku xidhka A,B,C,D si kasta uma samaynayo barbarro. Hubi in bartamaha labada geesood ee iska soo horjeeda isku mid yahay.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.explain: D-yada suurtagalka ah waa (9,5),(1,3),(−1,−3). Kuwani waa marka D ay ka soo horjeeddo A,B,C siday u kala horreeyaan; xaalad kasta bartamaha labada geesood ee iska soo horjeeda waa isku meel. (1, 3, 5, 9)
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Sharax sababta D aanu hal keliya u ahayn, iyo fikirkaaga inay jiri karaan D kale.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Calaamadee midka A,B,C ee dhibic kasta oo aad sawirtay ka soo horjeedo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tiri inta dhibcood ee ka soo horjeedi karta D.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxay sababta D isu beddesho iyadoo ku xiran dhibicda ay ka soo horjeeddo?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay xitaa hal sabab oo ku saabsan 'ma jiri karaan kuwo kale' (caddeynta inaan dhammaan kiisaska kala qaaday)?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ma doortay dhibic aan sawiray oo aan dib u hubiyay in dhinacyada iska soo horjeeda isbarbar socdaan?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.0: D waxay is beddeshaa iyadoo ku xiran labada dhibcood ee la iska soo horjeedsiiyo. Haddii A ka soo horjeeddo waa (9,5), B ka soo horjeeddo (1,3), C ka soo horjeeddo (−1,−3). A,B,C oo keliya ayaa D ka soo horjeedi kara, sidaas darteed intaas oo 3 ah ayaa jirta. (1, 3, 5, 9)
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Bartamaha diagonals-ku waa inay isku mid noqdaan; doorashada mid ka mid ah saddex dhibcood inuu D ka soo horjeedo waxay siinaysaa hal D. Saddex doorasho ayaa jirta, sidaas darteed D saddex boos ayuu leeyahay, wax ka badanna ma filayo. (3, 3)
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Xitaa haddii aanad isku-duwayaasha qorin, tirada iyo sababtu way ku filan yihiin.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.prompt: Xog cusub: markii su'aasha dib loo eegay waxay tidhi 'barbarro ABCD', geesahana waxay isugu xiran yihiin A,B,C,D (A iyo C waa iska soo horjeed, B iyo D waa iska soo horjeed). D hadda xaggee tahay?
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qor geesaha ABCD ee deriska la ah D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dooro dhibic oo hubi in dhaqdhaqaaqa dhinaca AB ilaa DC uu isku jiho iyo isku dherer yahay.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad u akhriday A iyo D inay iska soo horjeedaan. Kala horreynta ABCD, lammaanayaasha iska soo horjeeda waa A,C iyo B,D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad dhigtay B iyo D inay iska soo horjeedaan. Hubi in dhinacyada AB iyo DC ay isku jiho iyo dherer yihiin.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad u akhriday C iyo D inay iska soo horjeedaan. Kala horreynta ABCD, deriska C waa B iyo D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.o.d: Weligeed lama oga midka saddexda boos ah.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad seegtay in kala horreyntu go'aamiso lammaanayaasha iska soo horjeeda. Marka kala horreynta la bixiyo, qor kan A ka soo horjeeda iyo kan B ka soo horjeeda.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.explain: Kala horreynta ABCD, B iyo D waa iska soo horjeed, sidaas darteed D=A+C−B=(0+5−4,0+4−1)=(1,3). Hubin: AB=(4,1), DC=(5−1,4−3)=(4,1), waa isku mid. Xogta cusub waxay ka soo koobtay saddex boos oo suurtagal ah hal. (0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4)

z-m-33-02.thinking.1: Sake duba hukunci da amincewa yayin da sabon bayani ya zo.
z-m-33-02.title: Haddii xariiq soo baxdo, labada goobo ma kulmaan?
z-m-33-02.topic: Goobaha laba goobo iyo xariiqda ka soo baxda isla'egyada goobaha
z-m-33-02.goal: Ku tijaabi tusaalooyin in xitaa xariiq had iyo jeer ka soo baxdo isla'egyada labada goobo aysan kaligeed caddaynayn inay goobo is galaan, adiguna dhis laba goobo oo aan kulmin, sheegna waxa kale ee la hubinayo.
z-m-33-02.material: Isla'egta C1: x²+y²=4 (xarun (0,0), raadiyus 2). C2 xarunteedu (d,0), raadiyus r, d>0,r>0, isla'egteedu (x−d)²+y²=r². Hayun waxay dhinac dhinac uga jartay isla'egta C2 tan C1 si ay u hesho xariiq heerka koowaad ee x, waxayna tidhi, 'Xariiq baa soo baxday, markaa labada goobo waxay ku kulmaan labada dhibcood ee xariiqdu marto.' Halkan 'kulmaan' waxay ka dhigan tahay inay wadaagaan dhibic (taabashaduna way ku jirtaa). (0, 0, 4)
z-m-33-02.thinking.0: Bambance xaaladaha sheegashadu sax tahay iyo tusaalooyinka ay khaldan tahay
z-m-33-02.thinking.2: Adigu samee tusaalooyin diidmo ah oo u kala saar noocyo
z-m-33-02.prereq.0: Macnaha isla'egta goobada (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r², akhrinta xarunta iyo raadiyuska
z-m-33-02.prereq.1: Macnaha meelaynta laba goobo (kala fog, taabasho, laba meelood ku kulma, midda kale ku jirta)
z-m-33-02.prereq.2: (Shaqadan H2 waa habayn, heer adag mana aha fasal manhaj; waxaa loo qaadanayaa inay timaaddo ka dib isla'egta goobo ee xisaabta guud.)
z-m-33-02.s.s1.prompt: Xogtu mid mid ayay imanaysaa. Mar kasta qiimee inta meelood ee goobooyinku ku kulmaan iyo heerka kalsoonida hadalka Hayun.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isku-duwayaasha dhibic xariiqda saaran si toos ah ugu beddel isla'egta C1 si aad u hubiso inay buuxinayso.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.1: Marka d iyo r is beddelaan, isbarbar dhig masaafada labada xarumood iyo wadarta raadiyasyada.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ka jarista isla'egyada C1 iyo C2 waxay bixisaa 2dx=d²+4−r², sidaas darteed d aan 0 ahayn wuxuu keenayaa xariiq x qiime go'an leh. d iyo r weli lama sheegin.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Xariiq baa soo baxday keliya ma ku filan in la yidhaahdo goobooyinku way kulmaan?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Xariiq soo baxday waxay sheegaysaa 'haddii dhibco isgoys ahi jiraan, xariiqdan ayay saaran yihiin.' Jiritaanka dhibcaha waa in si gaar ah loo hubiyaa. Aan ku tijaabino xogta xigta.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waad odhan kartaa. Dhibic kasta oo labada goobo wadaagaan waxay saaran tahay xariiqdan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad 'haddii dhibic wadaag ahi jirto waxay saaran tahay xariiqda' u akhriday 'dhibic wadaag ahi way jirtaa'. Hadalka hore wuxuu ka hadlayaa xaalad dhibic jirto.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Maya. Waxa keliya ee la og yahay waa haddii ay jiraan dhibco kulan, inay xariiqdan saaran yihiin.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad kala saartay waxa xariiqdu sheegto iyo waxa aanay sheegin.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Maya. Xariiq soo baxdaa dhab ahaantii waxay ka dhigan tahay labada goobo ma kulmaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad xariiqda u qaadatay caddayn ka soo horjeedda. Ka fikir in xariiqdu sidoo kale u soo baxdo marka goobooyinku kulmaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Haddii aan la garanayn d iyo r, xariiqdani waxba kuuma sheegto.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Qiimayaashooda la'aantood lama oga inay kulmaan, laakiin waa la sheegi karaa meesha ay ku kulmi lahaayeen. Hubi inay xariiqdu wax xog ah siinayso.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Waxaa la sheegay d=6,r=1. Kala-goyntu waxay bixisaa 12x=39, xariiqda x=13/4=3.25. Dhibic xariiqdan ku taal inay C1 saarnaato waxay u baahan tahay y²=4−(13/4)²=−105/16 (y waa dhab).
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Goobooyinku imisa dhibcood ayay ku kulmaan?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.ask: Goobooyinku imisa dhibcood ayay ku kulmaan?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.after: y² waa taban, sidaas darteed xariiqdan ma laha dhibic C1 saaran. Tani waxay la jaanqaadaysaa masaafada xarumaha 6 oo ka weyn wadarta raadiyaska 3, goobooyinkuna way kala fog yihiin. Xariiq baa soo baxday, balse goobooyinku isma galaan. Xariiq soo bixitaankeedu caddayn kulan ma aha.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 2 dhibcood. Sida Hayun tidhi xariiq baa soo baxday, markaa laba meelood ayay ku kulmaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad weli xariiqda u aqbashay caddayn kulan. Hubi inay dhab ahaan jirto dhibic C1 saaran.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 1 dhibic. Xariiqda iyo C1 hal meel ayay ku kulmaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaad ka fikirtey xariiq iyo goobo isgoys, laakiin ma hubin calaamadda y². Haddii y² taban yahay, y dhab ahi ma jiraa?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 0 dhibcood. Xariiqda ma jiro dhibic C1 saaran.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad xukuntay adigoo eegaya natiijada isku-dubaridka dhibcaha xariiqda iyo isla'egta C1.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.info: d=3,r=2 ayaa la dhigay. Kala-goyntu waxay bixisaa 6x=9, xariiqda x=3/2. Marka C1 la geliyo y²=4−9/4=7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Markan imisa meelood ayay ku kulmaan?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.after: y=±√7/2 (qiyaastii ±1.32), sidaas darteed waxay ku kulmaan (3/2,±√7/2). C2-na way buuxisaa: (3/2−3)²+7/4=4. Xaaladdan Hayun way saxnayd. Waxa go'aamiya kulanku ma aha xariiq soo baxday ee waa inay C1 dhibco ku leedahay xariiqdaas.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 2 dhibcood. y wuxuu leeyahay laba qiime, togan iyo taban, sidaa darteed laba dhibcood ayay yihiin.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad y laba qiime ka soo saartay y²=7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 0 dhibcood. Xariiq baa soo baxday, sidii hore ma kulmaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad tusaalihii hore sidaas oo kale ugu dabaqday kan. Isbarbar dhig calaamadda y² markan iyo tii hore.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 1 dhibic. C1 hal dhibic oo keliya ayay xariiqdan ku leedahay.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.b: 1 dhibic. C1 hal dhibic oo keliya ayay xariiqdan ku leedahay.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka fikir inta y ee ka timaadda hal y². Haddii y² togan yahay imisa y ayaa jira?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.info: d=4,r=2 ayaa la dhigay. Kala-goyntu waxay bixisaa 8x=16, xariiqda x=2. C1 marka la geliyo y²=4−4=0.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.after: y=0 oo keliya ayaa jira, sidaas darteed waxay ku taabtaan hal dhibic (2,0). Masaafada xarumuhu waa 4, wadarta raadiyasyaduna 2+2=4. Halkan x=2 waa tangent guud. Xariiq baa soo bixi karta, haddana kulamadu waxay noqon karaan 0,1,2. (0, 0, 1, 2)
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.a: 0 dhibcood. Xariiq baa soo baxday balse C1 ma kulmaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad y²=0 u akhriday 'xal ma jiro'. Hubi inuu jiro y dhab ah oo buuxiya y²=0.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Waxaad ogaatay haddii y²=0, hal y oo keliya ayaa jira.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.c: 2 dhibcood. Sidii tallaabadii hore xariiqdu laba dhibcood ayay martaa.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Waxaad natiijadii tusaalihii hore sidii hore ugu dabaqday. Isbarbar dhig inta y ee ka timaadda qiimaha y² markan iyo tii hore.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.reflect: Sidee kalsoonidaada xariiq soo baxdo isu beddeshay marka tusaalooyinku socdaan? Maxaa ku kala duwanaa kiisaska hadalka Hayun sax iyo khalad ka ahaa? Maxaa mar kasta la hubiyaa marka xariiq soo baxdo?
z-m-33-02.s.s2.prompt: Samee tusaalooyin uu hadalka Hayun khaldan yahay. Dooro xarunta (d,0) iyo raadiyuska r ee C2, geli laba nooc oo kala duwan oo goobooyinku aanay kulmin. Mid ha ahaado kuwo bannaanka iska jira, midna mid goobo kale ku dhex jirto iyagoo aan kulmin. (2)
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig raadiyuska C1 ee 2 iyo r, ka fikir inta d ee xarumuhu isu jiraan si ay u kala fogaadaan.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.1: Si mid goobo kale ugu dhex jirto, tijaabi doorashada d adigoo la barbar dhigaya farqiga raadiyasyada.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.2: Markaad doorato musharraxiin, barbar dhig tusaalihii hore d=6,r=1 si aad u hubiso inay noocyo kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.ok.c1: d da r duka tabbatattu ne.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole d da r duka su fi 0.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Waɗannan da'irori biyu suna haɗuwa ko taɓa juna. Dole ne a ba da misalin da ba sa haɗuwa. Kwatanta tazarar cibiyoyin da radii.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.explain: Misali: (d, r) = (5, 1) yana da tazarar cibiyoyi 5, fiye da jimillar radii 3, don haka suna rabuwa a waje; kuma (1, 5) yana sa C2 ta ƙunshi C1, don haka ba sa haɗuwa (radius na C1 shi ne 2, tazarar cibiyoyi 1 kuma ta kasa da bambancin radii biyun, 3). A dukkan yanayin d > 0, layi yana samuwa, amma da'irorin ba sa haɗuwa. Taɓa daga ciki (misali d = 2, r = 4) yana haɗuwa a maki ɗaya, saboda haka ba ya ƙirga.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.prompt: Faɗa wa Hayun: idan an cire equations kuma layi ya fito, me kuma dole ne a duba kafin a ce 'da'irorin biyu sun haɗu', kuma me ya sa? Rubuta amsar.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta a layi ɗaya dalilin da ya sa a misalin d = 6, r = 1 ba su haɗu ba duk da cewa layi ya fito.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tuna irin lissafi ko kwatanci da ka yi amfani da shi a misalin don sanin cewa ba sa haɗuwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ko da layi ya fito, ...
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Na bambanta da kalmomi na cewa fitowar layi da haɗuwar da'irorin biyu ba abu ɗaya ba ne?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Idan na yi amfani da hanyar dubawa da na rubuta ga misalin d = 6, r = 1, shin sakamakon zai ce ba sa haɗuwa?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Na bayyana lokacin da maki da layin ya ratsa suke kan da'irorin biyu?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.0: Ko da layi ya fito, dole ne a bincika dabam ko akwai maki gama-gari na da'irorin biyu a kan wannan layin. Saka layin cikin equation na da'ira ɗaya a duba ko maki na haɗuwa na gaske ya fito; idan bai fito ba, da'irorin biyu ba sa haɗuwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.1: Haka kuma za a iya kwatanta tazarar cibiyoyin da jimilla ko bambancin radii. Layi yana fitowa koyaushe sai dai idan d = 0, saboda haka samuwar layi kaɗai ba ta tabbatar da maki haɗuwa ba; dole ne a duba ko da gaske akwai maki haɗuwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ana karɓar duka hanyar musanya cikin layi da hanyar kwatanta tazara.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.2: Dole ne a kwatanta tazara d tsakanin cibiyoyin da'irorin biyu da jimillar radii 2+r da bambancinsu |2-r|. Idan ta fi jimillar ko ta kasa da bambancin, da'irorin biyu ba sa haɗuwa ko da layi ya fito.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.modelNote.2: Ana karɓar amsar da ta yi amfani da kwatanta tazara ma.
